objects.taxonomy_description: Domestic swine measuring 90-180 cm body length weighing 50-350 kg. Body stocky and barrel-shaped with sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin. Head large with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting. Eyes small. Ears large and floppy or erect depending on breed. Legs short and stout with cloven hooves. Tail short and curly.
